description: This file defines a FastAPI route for handling chat interactions in a medical decision support chatbot. It sets up an API endpoint '/chat' which processes patient messages, generates responses via a patient agent, updates session notes, and stores them externally. It also adds disclaimers to responses. The file imports several modules related to models, services, utilities, and routes, and registers the route handler with FastAPI's router.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI class used to define API routes

classes.name: PatientAgent
classes.description: Agent class responsible for processing patient messages

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: Service class for persisting session notes

methods.name: chat(req: ChatRequest)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /chat, processes the message from a patient, updates structured notes, and stores session notes. Generates a response with the reply message and notes, adding disclaimers.
